notes.title: Information to Update Industry Transporters v0.7.660
notes.content:
Build 0.7.660 
 Changes: 

Research Tree Changed:
[olist] 
Each Vehicle Tree is now unique with unique research skills
Added also first tree for industry/store upgrades
Shows way better actual state and progress via lines and background textures
Information about each Research is now a bit more detailed (requirements also listed / level shows actual and max one)
removed the tier system (made it too complicated)
research icons redone
 [/olist] 
Done a few changes to Worldmap:
[olist] 
Is now also fullscreen like research window
shows legend on the side
more accurate in finding the position
 [/olist]

Fixed a few issues in finding terminal position
Fixed an issue where the AI didn't checked range between industries and town (would sometimes create production over half the map)
Fixed a few errors that could occur while the AI was running
 [/olist] 
Truck issue fixes:
[olist] 
Fixed an issue where a truck could get into a loop due not reaching his goal with his detection system (increased detection range from 30 to 100)
Fixed also an issue where trucks would get stuck when moving in an end (the turnaround function was missing at that point in the code)
Fixed path finding over freeway parts (was still a bit wonky)
 [/olist] 
Fixed a few issues with registering and calculating repair costs
Fixed wrong localization for wheel menu
Fixed a few building issues when building freeway
Fixed a rotation issue with trucks and trains that could lead to reaching the wrong tile in a curve (now calculates the movement better)
lowered glow on all texts a bit to make it better readable
info window show timer will reset now every time mouse is moved (could be a pain when it opened even when moving mouse just because staying on same block)
Fixed a few other smaller issues

notes.title: Update Log for Industry Transporters v0.7.620
notes.content:
Build 0.7.620
 Changes: 

Balance changes: 
[olist]
Product: Wheels, now needs only 1x rubber instead of 2x (caused cars to use too much raw rubber for a single car)
Raw Rubber Production Increased by x1.35
[/olist]
Changed and re-enabled wheel menu: 
[olist]
added missing new buttons (more building categories and lists)
fixed a few issues
[/olist]
Demolishing tool mechanics changed: 
[olist]
is now selecting via holding left mouse button
releasing left mouse button will trigger now demolishing
pressing right mouse button while holding left mouse button will cancel demolishing
[/olist]
Deform tool mechanics optimized: 
[olist]
Deform point will now be controlled better (Will find now nearest point instead of always left down of mouse cursor)
New Area Flatten Mode (Right Mouse Button) = will now use cerulean colored point as for changing everything around it to the same level (often more expensive)
[/olist]
Done a few optimizations in the path building function (should cause less lags/faster building)
 

 Fixes:  

Fixed an issue where the loading system tried to load a wrong slot when there are some free slots between saved games
Fixed some issues where the space of a terminal could be filled due vehicles not unregistering themselves (will do now extra check when full, if it is really still filled)
Fixed a few errors that could occur when changing material on objects
Fixed an issue with positioning "Air Terminal (Normal)"
Fixed an issue where it was impossible to build electric or mono rail terminals
Fixed an issue where the details were not added when removing a building
Fixed also an issue in turning vehicles on a hill street (could lead to vehicles below map, stopped turning there for the time being)
Fixed a few path building issues as it would sometimes create normal street instead 	of an hill one
Fixed a few issues in research window: 
[olist]
Fixed missing tooltip
Fixed research icons not showing state "unable to research"
[/olist]
Fixed also a few issues with trains: 
[olist]
Fixed an issue where turning around function was bugged
Fixed a few more issues with setting position of trailers (would set them next to train on some models)
[/olist]
Fixed a few StackOverflowExeptions: 
[olist]
Fixed Error when removing all used marker points
Fixed Error when closing new building menu
[/olist]
Fixed quite a few UI issues: 
[olist]
Building Menu would sometimes close when changing just left panel buttons (was not needed for some buttons to close)
Left Panel building menu was not unsetting buttons when changing between industry and store
Windows could still be opened when using a mouse mode
[/olist]
Fixed a lot of issues with bridges and tunnels: 
[olist]
Fixed an issue when moving over a bridge or in a tunnel setting move speed to 0 of a vehicle/train
It was possible to modify terrain on a bridge/tunnel starting point
Fixed a few issues removing them (would leave some data back which was detected when building another bridge/tunnel over the same area)
[/olist]
